standard_prerequisites.name: There exists c in the intersection of the height-one primes p_i such that A/cA is reduced
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the element c with the required reduced quotient.

standard_prerequisites.name: In a normal domain, an element x lies in A as soon as it lies in each localization at a height-one prime
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the effectivity of the divisor into the containment c^n/a in A.

core_obligations: Write div(a) = sum n_i p_i using the notation of the proof of the radical-element lemma, and choose c in p_1 intersect ... intersect p_r with A/cA reduced by the radical-element lemma (proof lines 38247-38250). For n >= max(n_i) the divisor -div(a) + div(c^n) has all coefficients nonnegative, hence is effective; therefore c^n/a lies in each localization of A at a height-one prime, and since A is normal the intersection-of-localizations lemma gives c^n/a in A, i.e. a divides c^n (proof lines 38251-38254).
proof_roadmap: Choose c with reduced quotient via the radical-element lemma (proof lines 38247-38250).
Make -div(a) + div(c^n) effective and conclude c^n/a in A by normality (proof lines 38251-38254).
